title: Brand Guidelines
meta: Simple written rules for look, tone and replies so every post sounds like you. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Social media brand guidelines for look, tone and replies
overview: When more than one person posts, a brand starts to drift. We write a short, practical guide that keeps everyone on track: your colors and fonts, photo style, tone of voice with examples, words to use and avoid, how to handle comments and complaints, and what you never post. It is written for busy people, not designers, and delivered as a short PDF you can share with anyone who posts for you.

pkgs.blurb: A two page guide on voice, look and do and don't.
A fuller guide with sample posts and reply rules.
A complete social playbook with templates and a team briefing.
list: Approval steps and who posts what

faq: Do I need a logo and colors already?
It helps. If you have only a logo, we pick matching colors and fonts for you to approve. A full logo or brand design is a separate service.
Will the guide sound like us?
We read your site, posts and any emails you share, then write the tone guidance from what you already do well. You review a draft and can change anything within your revisions.
Can I share the guide with freelancers?
Yes, that is the point. It is a plain PDF with clear rules, so a freelancer or new team member can follow it from their first day.
Will you apply the guide to my profiles?
The guide itself does not edit your accounts. The profile setup and post design services apply the rules, and you can add them if you want us to do the work.
